basic_details.job_title: IIT Ropar Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Ropar, Rupnagar, Punjab, has advertised one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the ANRF-ARG sponsored project "Unveiling Altermagnetic Order through Spin-Orbit Torque and Transport in Thin Film Devices", open to Indian nationals. The pay is Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month. The essential qualification is an M.Sc or equivalent degree in Physics with 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5/10) and a valid GATE/CSIR-UGC NET/LS/JEST qualification. Documents must be emailed as a single PDF to [email protected] on or before 23 November 2026, and the walk-in inter

how_to_apply: Prepare a single PDF containing all the documents listed below.
Email the PDF to [email protected] (Dr. Debangsu Roy) on or before 23 November 2026.
Appear for the walk-in interview on 24 November 2026 at 11 AM, bringing all original certificates.
The notice does not mention an email subject line.
A one-page cover letter describing the background and how it will help to pursue this project.
A Curriculum Vitae (CV) with complete qualification and experience details.
Soft copy of all degree certificates.
All original certificates, to be brought to the interview.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Extension beyond the first year depends on satisfactory performance and is on an annual basis. On-campus accommodation may be provided, subject to availability. Principal Investigator's contact: Dr. Debangsu Roy, Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Ropar, Rupnagar-140001, Punjab; email [email protected]; group webpage https://sites.google.com/view/debangsu.

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Unveiling Altermagnetic Order through Spin-Orbit Torque and Transport in Thin Film Devices
Initially one year, extendable annually up to 3 years or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier
Department of Physics, IIT Ropar, Rupnagar, Punjab
Documents by email as a single PDF, then walk-in interview (offline mode)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. The essential and desirable qualifications printed in the notice are below. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc or equivalent degree in Physics with 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5/10) and valid GATE/CSIR-UGC NET/LS/JEST qualified
rows.desirable: Research experience in experimental condensed matter physics and proficiency in C/C++/Java/Python or LabVIEW

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month. Suitable on-campus accommodation may be provided, subject to availability. The initial duration is one year. It can be extended on an annual basis, based on satisfactory performance, up to 3 years or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The selected candidate may be considered for PhD admission within a year, as per the Institute's rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Ropar Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Prepare a single PDF containing all the documents listed below. Email the PDF to [email protected] (Dr. Debangsu Roy) on or before 23 November 2026. Appear for the walk-in interview on 24 November 2026 at 11 AM, bringing all original certificates. The notice does not mention an email subject line. A one-page cover letter describing the background and how it will help to pursue this project. A Curriculum Vitae (CV) with complete qualification and experience details. Soft copy of all degree certificates. Proof of GATE/NET/JEST qualification. All original certificates, to be brought to the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates with the stated qualification are invited to appear for a walk-in interview in offline mode before the selection committee. The interview is on 24 November 2026 at 11 AM in the Department of Physics, IIT Ropar. The venue is the Super Academic Block (SAB), Conference Room (Physics Department), IIT Ropar.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Extension beyond the first year depends on satisfactory performance and is on an annual basis. On-campus accommodation may be provided, subject to availability. Principal Investigator's contact: Dr. Debangsu Roy, Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Ropar, Rupnagar-140001, Punjab; email [email protected] ; group webpage https://sites.google.com/view/debangsu .

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there at IIT Ropar?
faq.answer: There is one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position, which the notice says is available immediately.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Ropar JRF post?
faq.answer: Documents must be emailed on or before 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Ropar JRF post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is an M.Sc or equivalent degree in Physics with 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5/10), plus valid GATE/CSIR-UGC NET/LS/JEST qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Ropar JRF?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IIT Ropar JRF post?
faq.answer: Send a cover letter, CV, soft copies of degree certificates and proof of GATE/NET/JEST qualification as a single PDF to [email protected] (Dr. Debangsu Roy) by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. When and where is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 24 November 2026 at 11 AM at the Super Academic Block (SAB), Conference Room (Physics Department), IIT Ropar. Candidates should bring all original certificates.

faq.question: Q7. Is the IIT Ropar JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. It starts for one year and can be extended annually up to 3 years or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37,000?
faq.answer: The pay is printed as Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month, so HRA is mentioned in addition to the Rs. 37,000. On-campus accommodation may be provided, subject to availability.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the selected JRF be considered for PhD admission?
faq.answer: The notice says the selected candidate may be considered for PhD admission within a year, as per the Institute's rules.
